Analogies.question: ১) 'Sea' is related to 'Ship' in the same way as 'Road' is related to:
Analogies.exp: As the means of transport in 'Sea' is 'Ship', similarly the means of transport on 'Road' is 'Bus'

Analogies.question: ২) 'Mountain' is related to 'Hill' in the same way as 'River' is related to:
Analogies.exp: As short form of 'Mountain' is 'Hill' similarly 'Tank' is short form of 'River'.

Analogies.question: ৩) 'Smoke' is related to 'Pollution' in the same way as 'War' is related to:
Analogies.exp: As 'smoke' leads to 'pollution' in the same way ''War'' leads to 'destruction'.

Analogies.question: ৪) 'Wax' is related to 'Grease' in the same way as 'Milk' is related to:
Analogies.exp:
As 'Grease' is prepared from 'Wax' in the same way 'Curd' is prepared from 'Milk'.
ঘি হবে না। কারণ ঘি দুধ থেকে Extract করা হয়। কিন্তু, Grease Wax থেকে Extract করা হয় না।
তেলের সাথে Wax যোগ করে Grease তৈরি হয়। আর দুধের সাথে এসিডিক কিছু মেলালে হয় Curd.

Analogies.question: ৫) 'Flower' is related to 'Bud' in the same way as 'Fruit' is related to:
Analogies.exp: As 'Flower' is made from 'Bud' similarly 'Fruit' is made from 'Flower'.

Analogies.question: ৬) 'Reading' is related to 'knowledge' in the same way as 'Work' is related to:
Analogies.exp: As 'Knowledge' is achieved by 'Reading' in the same way 'Experience' is achieved by 'Work'.

Analogies.question: ৭) 'Indolence' is related to 'Work' in the same way as 'Taciturn' is related to:
Analogies.exp: As 'Indolence' and 'Work' are opposite to each other in the same way 'Taciturn' and 'speak' are opposite to each other.

Analogies.question: ৮) Soldier : Gun : : Blacksmith : ?
Analogies.exp: Soldier uses Gun and Blacksmith uses Hammer

Analogies.question: ৯) Disease : Health : : Freedom : ?
Analogies.exp: Disease is the antonym of Health and the antonym of Freedom will be Slavery.

Analogies.question: ১০) Crime : Punishment : : Deed : ?
Analogies.exp: Punishment is the result of Crime. In the same way Prize is the result of Deeds

Analogies.question: ১১) Butter : Milk : : Oil : ?
Analogies.exp: Butter is obtained from Milk and Oil is obtained from Seeds.

Analogies.question: ১২) ABC : ZYX : : CBA : ?
Analogies.exp: Here A has been used in place of Z, B for Y and C for X everywhere.

Analogies.question: ১৩) NUMBER : UNBMRE : : GHOST : ?
Analogies.exp: Every pair of letters in the terms are in reverse order as NU = UN, MB = BM and ER = RE.

Analogies.question: ১৪) Waiting : Boredom : : Education : ?
Analogies.exp: Waiting leads to Boredom and Education leads to Enlightenment.

Analogies.question: ১৫) Angry. : Night : : ? : Day
Analogies.exp: First terms is the opposite of the IIIrd term as is the case with IInd and IVth terms

Analogies.question: ১৬) Parrot : Cage : : Man : ?
Analogies.exp: Parrot is kept into Cage. Similarly Man is kept into Prison after trial

Analogies.question: ১৭) Monday : April : : Friday : ?
Analogies.exp: Fridays comes three days after Monday so three month after April will be August

Analogies.question: ১৮) Handsome : Beautiful : : Husband : ?
Analogies.exp: Handsome is related to Husband and Beautiful is related to Wife.

Analogies.question: ১৯) Light : Sun : : Heat : ?
Analogies.exp: Sun gives-light. In the same way Fire gives heat.

Analogies.question:
২০) Each of the following questions has a group. Find out which one of the given alternatives will be another member of the group or of that class.
Apple, Grape, Orange
Analogies.exp: Apple, Grape and Orange all these are fruits.

Analogies.question: ২১) Pathology, Cardiology, Radiology, Ophthalmology
Analogies.exp: As all terms given in the question are medical terms and Hematology is also medical term.

Analogies.question: ২২) Volleyball, Hockey, Football
Analogies.exp: Baseball is like volleyball, Hockey and Football.

Analogies.question: ২৩) Carpenter, Plumber, Electrician
Analogies.exp: Carpenter, Plumber, Electrician and Blacksmith are in same working category.

Analogies.question: ২৪) Tamilian, Gujarati, Punjabi
Analogies.exp: All these words represent the inhabitants of India.

Analogies.question:
২৫) In each word of the following questions consists of pair of words bearing a relationship among these, from amongst the alternatives, pick up the pair that best illustrate a similar relationship.
Glove : Hand-
Analogies.exp: As Glove is worn in Hands similarly Socks are worn on feet.

Analogies.question: ২৬) Silence : Noise-
Analogies.exp: As Silence is opposite to noise, similarly Baldness is opposite to Hair.

Analogies.question: ২৭) Scales : Fish-
Analogies.exp: As scales from an outer layer of fish similarly skin form an outer layer of man.

Analogies.question: ২৮) Sunrise : Sunset-
Analogies.exp: At sunrise morning begins, similarly at sunset night begins.

Analogies.question: ২৯) Train : Track-
Analogies.exp: As Train is guided by the track similarly Bullet is guided by the barrel.

Analogies.question: ৩০) Rectangle : Pentagon-
Analogies.exp: Second one had one more side than the first.

Analogies.question: ৩১) Thermometer : Temperature
Analogies.exp: As temperature is measured from a thermometer in the same way heart rate is measured with cardiograph.

Analogies.question:
৩২) In each of the following questions find out the alternative which will replace the question mark.
CUP : LIP :: BIRD : ?
Analogies.exp: Cup is used to drink something with the help of lips. Similarly birds collects grass with the help of beak to make her nest.

Analogies.question: ৩৩) Ornithologist : Bird :: Archaeologist : ?
Analogies.exp: As Ornithologist is a specialist of Birds similarly Archaeologist is a specialist of Archaeology.

Analogies.question: ৩৪) Architect : Building :: Sculptor : ?
Analogies.exp: As 'Architect' makes 'Building' similarly 'Sculptor' makes 'Statue'.

Analogies.question: ৩৫) Microphone : Loud :: Microscope : ?
Analogies.exp: As Microphone makes sound louder similarly Microscope makes the object magnified.

Analogies.question: ৩৬) College : Student :: Hospital : ?
Analogies.exp: As Students read in College similarly Patients are treated in Hospital.

Analogies.question: ৩৭) Country : President :: State : ?
Analogies.exp: As President is the nominal head of a country, similarly Governer is the nominal head of a State.

Analogies.question: ৩৮) Peace : Chaos :: Creation : ?
Analogies.exp: As opposite meaning of peace is chaos similarly opposite meaning of creation is destruction.

Analogies.question: ৩৯) Poles : Magnet :: ? : Battery
Analogies.exp: As magnet has poles similarly battery has terminals.

Analogies.question: ৪০) Ice : Coldness :: Earth : ?
Analogies.exp: As effect of Ice is coldness similarly the effect of Earth is gravitation.

Analogies.question: ৪১) 'Rabbit' is related to 'Burrow' in the same way as 'Lunatic' is related to:
Analogies.exp: As the dwelling place of 'Rabbit' is 'Burrow' in the same way the dwelling place of 'Lunatic' is 'Asylum'.

Analogies.question: ৪২) BLOCKED : YOLXPVW :: ? : OZFMXS
৪৩) REASON : SFBTPO :: THINK : ?
৪৪) TALE : LATE :: ? : CAFE
Analogies.exp:
Tale ==> LATE [First and third letter interchanged their positions.]
Thus,
FACE ==> CAFE.

Analogies.question: ৪৫) Odometer is to mileage as compass is to
Analogies.exp: An odometer is an instrument used to measure mileage. A compass is an instrument used to determine direction. Choices a, b, and c are incorrect because none is an instrument.

Analogies.question: ৪৬) Cup is to coffee as bowl is to
Analogies.exp: Coffee goes into a cup and soup goes into a bowl. Choices a and c are incorrect because they are other utensils. The answer is not choice d because the word food is too general.

Analogies.question: ৪৭) Optimist is to cheerful as pessimist is to
Analogies.exp: An optimist is a person whose outlook is cheerful. A pessimist is a person whose outlook is gloomy. The answer is not (choice b) because a pessimist does not have to be mean. (Choices c) and d are incorrect because neither adjective describes the outlook of a pessimist.

Analogies.question: ৪৮) Careful is to cautious as boastful is to
Analogies.exp: Careful and cautious are synonyms (they mean the same thing). Boastful and arrogant are also synonyms. The answer is not (choice b) because humble means the opposite of boastful. The answer is not choice c or d because neither means the same as boastful.

Analogies.question: ৪৯) Secretly is to openly as silently is to
Analogies.exp: Secretly is the opposite of openly, and silently is the opposite of noisily. Choices a and b are clearly not the opposites of silently. (Choice d) means the same thing as silently.

Analogies.question: ৫০) Candid is to indirect as honest is to
Analogies.exp:
Candid and indirect refer to opposing traits. Honest and untruthful refer to opposing traits.
The answer is not choice a) because, Frank means the same thing as candid.
Wicked (choice b) is incorrect because, even though it refers to a negative trait, it does not mean the opposite of honest.
Choice c) is incorrect because Truthful and Honest mean the same thing.
